entries.examples/board/web/node/**/*.ts: the Node.js server of the board example, which its README runs: node/main.ts and the files it imports
entries.examples/board/web/client/**/*.ts: the browser client of the board example, which its README builds: client/main.ts

binaries.go: the Go toolchain that scripts/go-test.mts runs in each Go module
binaries.hdiutil: the macOS tool that tests/darwin mounts the case-sensitive image with, run only on macOS by make flowmark-test

ignore.packages/go/store/testdata/slug/vscode-s: the VS Code slugify source that store tests read as data; scripts/record-slugs.mts writes it, and nothing imports it
